title: A price uses an identified calculation strategy and context
question: A delegated strategy and a stored-price getter are distinct mechanisms; naming a strategy does not establish its financial behavior.

evidence.title: A pricing strategy is selected explicitly before delegation
explanation: DelegatingCalculator rejects a subject with null calculator type and otherwise delegates using its named strategy, configuration and supplied context. StandardCalculator simply returns the stored price.

The sole spec file tests standard stored-price return (1299), not missing strategy or registry failure. No volume-pricing implementation exists among these source files merely because a constant names it. No currency, rounding or discount rule is inferred.

evidence.title: Bond-equivalent yield embeds integer constant and host-zone policies
explanation: T-bill long-branch denominator uses integer 365/2 and date-component branches depend on host local zone.

The expression dsm-365/2 contains integer constant division, yielding 182 before float subtraction rather than 182.5. time.Unix(...).Date reads local-zone calendar components for NASD/European and leap/year branches, while actual-day DaysDifference divides elapsed seconds by86400. This supports language/policy concerns but does not establish a replacement bond formula or a FinKore bond requirement.

Use the ordinary long T-bill branch, or date-component inputs whose local calendar date changes across zones. Short-branch formulas and elapsed-seconds branch have separate behavior; no numeric yield or timezone experiment was executed. Static review of the pinned bodies and prior attributed dependency contracts only; no upstream build, runtime outcome, deployed state or concurrency schedule was executed. This behavior is not currently defined by FinKore Core.

evidence.title: Comparative chart dates come from only the first instrument
explanation: Comparative chart assigns every series the first instrument dates without date joins.

lineChartMult builds Date from the first symbol, then writes each price vector by row position and melts by that Date column. Equal-length series recorded on different dates are therefore paired with the first dates at the data-frame boundary. Plot rendering and market facts remain external.

Two equal-length instrument series with different date sequences. Already aligned inputs avoid the mismatch; unequal lengths may instead trigger R recycling/error. No live chart or market data was rendered.
